contradictions.quote_a: Segregate any return marked as hazmat, leaking or odorous and place it adjacent to the hazmat cage for specialist assessment.
contradictions.quote_b: Never store hazmat outside the cage, even temporarily.
contradictions.explanation: One passage requires placing hazmat returns outside the cage while the other prohibits storing any hazmat outside the cage.

contradictions.quote_a: Reject returns outside this window unless the shift supervisor instructs otherwise.
contradictions.quote_b: Requests received after this period will be declined unless otherwise agreed in writing with the client.
contradictions.explanation: One passage gives the shift supervisor authority to accept late returns while the other requires written client agreement for the same exception.
